description: dropped PARTITION BY tenant_id — running total is global, not per-tenant
sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', issued_at)::date AS month_start, tenant_id, currency_code, SUM(total_cents) AS revenue FROM billing.invoices WHERE status IN ('paid','partial') AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', issued_at), tenant_id, currency_code) SELECT month_start, tenant_id, currency_code, revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total FROM monthly ORDER BY tenant_id, month_start;

description: LEAD instead of LAG — delta points the wrong way
sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT substr(issued_at,1,7)||'-01' AS month_start, SUM(total_cents) AS revenue FROM billing_invoices WHERE status IN ('paid','partial') AND deleted_at IS NULL AND currency_code='USD' GROUP BY substr(issued_at,1,7)) SELECT month_start, revenue, revenue - LEAD(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS mom_delta FROM monthly ORDER BY month_start;

description: dropped currency_code='USD' — sums all currencies as USD
sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', issued_at) AS DATE) AS month_start, SUM(total_cents) AS revenue FROM billing.invoices WHERE status IN ('paid','partial') AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', issued_at) AS DATE)) SELECT month_start, revenue, revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS mom_delta FROM monthly ORDER BY month_start;

description: INNER JOIN drops tenants with no USD-paid invoices
sql: WITH per AS (SELECT t.tenant_id, SUM(CASE WHEN i.status IN ('paid','partial') AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.currency_code='USD' THEN i.total_cents ELSE 0 END) AS total FROM billing_tenants t JOIN billing_invoices i ON i.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.tenant_id) SELECT tenant_id, total, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS rnk FROM per ORDER BY total DESC, tenant_id ASC;

description: dropped status IN ('paid','partial') — counts all statuses
sql: WITH per AS (SELECT t.tenant_id, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.currency_code='USD' THEN i.total_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total FROM billing.tenants t LEFT JOIN billing.invoices i ON i.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.tenant_id) SELECT tenant_id, total, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS rnk FROM per ORDER BY total DESC, tenant_id ASC;

description: missing deleted_at IS NULL — soft-deleted subs appear
sql: SELECT s.subscription_id, s.tenant_id, s.plan_id, p.base_price_cents, s.started_at AS subscription_start, GREATEST(0, CAST(date_diff('day', s.started_at, TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-30 00:00:00+00') AS BIGINT)) AS days_active FROM billing.subscriptions s JOIN billing.plans p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id ORDER BY s.subscription_id;

description: wrong status value — 'open' instead of 'paid'
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT tenant_id, invoice_id, status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tenant_id ORDER BY issued_at DESC, invoice_id DESC) AS rn FROM billing.invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) SELECT r.tenant_id, r.invoice_id FROM ranked r JOIN billing.tenants t ON t.tenant_id = r.tenant_id WHERE r.rn = 1 AND r.status = 'open' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.tenant_id;

description: ORDER BY adjusted_total DESC — picks largest, not smallest
sql: WITH adj AS (SELECT invoice_id, COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0) AS s FROM billing.invoice_adjustments GROUP BY invoice_id) SELECT i.invoice_id, i.tenant_id, i.total_cents, COALESCE(a.s, 0) AS adj_sum, i.total_cents + COALESCE(a.s, 0) AS adjusted_total FROM billing.invoices i LEFT JOIN adj a ON a.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY adjusted_total DESC, i.invoice_id ASC LIMIT 5;

description: LIMIT 2 instead of LIMIT 3 — top 2 distinct instead of top 3
sql: SELECT invoice_id, tenant_id, total_cents FROM billing_invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND total_cents IN (SELECT DISTINCT total_cents FROM billing_invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY total_cents DESC LIMIT 2) ORDER BY total_cents DESC, invoice_id ASC;

description: dropped currency match p.currency_code = t.currency_code — pays across currencies combined
sql: WITH pay AS (SELECT tenant_id, SUM(amount_cents) AS paid FROM billing.payments WHERE status='succeeded' GROUP BY tenant_id), ref AS (SELECT tenant_id, SUM(amount_cents) AS refunded FROM billing.refunds GROUP BY tenant_id) SELECT t.tenant_id, t.currency_code, COALESCE(p.paid, 0) AS paid_cents, COALESCE(r.refunded, 0) AS refunded_cents FROM billing.tenants t LEFT JOIN pay p ON p.tenant_id = t.tenant_id LEFT JOIN ref r ON r.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.tenant_id;

description: missing s.deleted_at IS NULL on the outer subscriptions filter
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT subscription_id, invoice_id, issued_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id ORDER BY issued_at DESC, invoice_id DESC) AS rn FROM billing.invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND subscription_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT s.subscription_id, s.tenant_id, r.invoice_id, r.issued_at AS last_issued_at FROM billing.subscriptions s LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.subscription_id = s.subscription_id AND r.rn = 1 WHERE s.ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.subscription_id;

description: wrong JSON path: $.path instead of $.endpoint
sql: SELECT json_extract(payload, '$.path') AS endpoint, COUNT(*) AS n FROM billing_usage_events ue JOIN billing_tenants t ON t.tenant_id = ue.tenant_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND ue.event_at >= '2026-06-01T00:00:00+00:00' AND ue.event_at < '2026-07-01T00:00:00+00:00' AND json_extract(payload, '$.path') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY endpoint ORDER BY n DESC, endpoint ASC;

description: api_total now excludes NULL client payloads — missing OR IS NULL
sql: SELECT ue.tenant_id, SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract_string(ue.payload, '$.client')='web' THEN ue.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS web_total, SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract_string(ue.payload, '$.client')='mobile' THEN ue.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_total, SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract_string(ue.payload, '$.client')='api' THEN ue.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS api_total FROM billing.usage_events ue JOIN billing.tenants t ON t.tenant_id = ue.tenant_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND ue.event_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-01 00:00:00+00' AND ue.event_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY ue.tenant_id ORDER BY ue.tenant_id;

description: swapped = and <> — reports counts under the wrong headings
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (li.unit_price_e4 * li.quantity) / 10000 <> li.amount_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS consistent_n, SUM(CASE WHEN (li.unit_price_e4 * li.quantity) / 10000 = li.amount_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inconsistent_n FROM billing_invoice_line_items li JOIN billing_invoices i ON i.invoice_id = li.invoice_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL;

description: dropped PARTITION BY tenant_id — running total across all tenants
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT tenant_id, substr(issued_at, 1, 7) || '-01' AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS n FROM billing_invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND issued_at >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00' AND issued_at < '2027-01-01T00:00:00+00:00' GROUP BY tenant_id, substr(issued_at, 1, 7)) SELECT tenant_id, month_start, n, SUM(n) OVER (ORDER BY month_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_n FROM m ORDER BY tenant_id, month_start;

description: EXISTS instead of NOT EXISTS — returns plans WITH active subs AND with ended subs
sql: SELECT p.code FROM billing_plans p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM billing_subscriptions s WHERE s.plan_id = p.plan_id AND s.ended_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM billing_subscriptions s WHERE s.plan_id = p.plan_id AND s.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL) ORDER BY p.code;

description: dropped p1.code < p2.code — returns (A,B) and (B,A) and self (A,A)
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p1.code AS plan_code_a, p2.code AS plan_code_b FROM billing.subscriptions s1 JOIN billing.plans p1 ON p1.plan_id = s1.plan_id JOIN billing.subscriptions s2 ON s2.tenant_id = s1.tenant_id AND s2.subscription_id <> s1.subscription_id AND s2.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN billing.plans p2 ON p2.plan_id = s2.plan_id WHERE s1.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY plan_code_a ASC, plan_code_b ASC;

description: LAG ordered DESC — 'previous' now means later in time
sql: SELECT invoice_id, issued_at, total_cents, LAG(total_cents) OVER (ORDER BY issued_at DESC, invoice_id DESC) AS prev_total, SUM(total_cents) OVER (ORDER BY issued_at ASC, invoice_id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total FROM billing_invoices WHERE tenant_id = 10001 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY issued_at, invoice_id;

description: DENSE_RANK instead of RANK — ties don't skip ranks, so sequence differs where ties exist (every seed has at least one tenant with tied paid invoice totals)
sql: SELECT invoice_id, tenant_id, total_cents, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tenant_id ORDER BY total_cents DESC) AS r FROM billing.invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status='paid' AND currency_code='USD' ORDER BY tenant_id ASC, r ASC, invoice_id ASC;

description: INNER drops tenants with zero paid invoices (nasty seed has Quiet Holdings)
sql: SELECT t.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT substr(i.issued_at, 1, 7)) AS n_months FROM billing_tenants t JOIN billing_invoices i ON i.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND i.status='paid' AND i.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.tenant_id ORDER BY t.tenant_id;

description: <> 'paid' instead of = 'paid' — ratio is of NON-paid invoices
sql: SELECT t.tenant_id, COUNT(i.invoice_id) AS count_all, SUM(CASE WHEN i.status<>'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_paid, SUM(CASE WHEN i.status<>'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1000 / COUNT(i.invoice_id) AS paid_ratio_pm FROM billing.tenants t JOIN billing.invoices i ON i.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND i.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.tenant_id HAVING COUNT(i.invoice_id) > 0 ORDER BY t.tenant_id;

description: NOT IN instead of IN on timezone list
sql: SELECT t.tenant_id, COUNT(ue.event_id) AS n FROM billing.tenants t JOIN billing.usage_events ue ON ue.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.billing_timezone NOT IN ('America/Los_Angeles','Europe/London') AND ue.event_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-03-01 00:00:00+00' AND ue.event_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-04-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY t.tenant_id ORDER BY t.tenant_id;

description: uses amount_cents directly without subtracting used credit_transactions.delta_cents
sql: SELECT t.tenant_id, COALESCE(SUM(c.amount_cents), 0) AS total_balance FROM billing.tenants t LEFT JOIN billing.credits c ON c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.tenant_id ORDER BY t.tenant_id;

description: r = 1 instead of r = 2 — returns the max instead of second-highest
sql: SELECT total_cents FROM (SELECT DISTINCT total_cents, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_cents DESC) AS r FROM billing_invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status='paid') x WHERE r = 1 LIMIT 1;

description: EXCEPT instead of INTERSECT
sql: SELECT tenant_id FROM audit.notifications WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2027-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND channel='email' EXCEPT SELECT tenant_id FROM audit.notifications WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2027-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND channel='sms' ORDER BY tenant_id;

description: LAG without PARTITION BY tenant_id — previous month bleeds across tenants
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT tenant_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', issued_at)::date AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS paid_count, SUM(total_cents) AS paid_total_cents FROM billing.invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status='paid' GROUP BY tenant_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', issued_at)) SELECT tenant_id, month_start, paid_count, paid_total_cents, LAG(paid_total_cents) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_month_total FROM m ORDER BY tenant_id, month_start;
